Manual SSH Key Setup Instructions
=================================

If cPanel's import isn't working, try this manual method:

1. Connect to your server using VS Code SSH (with password)

2. Once connected, run these commands:

   mkdir -p ~/.ssh
   chmod 700 ~/.ssh
   touch ~/.ssh/authorized_keys
   chmod 600 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys

3. Open the authorized_keys file:
   nano ~/.ssh/authorized_keys

4. Paste this ENTIRE line (all on one line):
ssh-rsa  adamstack@stackmap-cpanel

5. Save and exit:
   - Press Ctrl+X
   - Press Y
   - Press Enter

6. Test from your local machine:
   ssh stackmap-cpanel

If this still doesn't work, the server might have SSH key authentication disabled.
Check with: grep "PubkeyAuthentication" /etc/ssh/sshd_config
